activities.hint: Tap a sentence to hear it. Read it with your finger under each word.

wida: Match a decodable word to an image

teacher.use: Small group or partners. The child taps each sentence to hear it, then chooses a picture; reading a short word.
teacher.lower: Read each sentence aloud together while pointing to each word.
teacher.onLevel: The child reads first, taps only the words they need, then answers.
teacher.challenge: Ask the child to find and read the sentence that proves the answer.
teacher.noTech: Write the sentences on chart paper and draw the choices on cards.
teacher.prompt: Which sentence helped you? Read it to me.
